entry.title: Kızıl Kule
entry.note: The eight mapped major corners are authored directly in the cached native frame. The small west-facing entrance and northern inscription tablet resolve rotational ambiguity; lowest eastern base is the ground contact datum. The adjoining city walls are separate structures. The documented 3 m western ground rise is not baked into a terrain slab; the tower retains the complete lower eastern wall for terrain placement. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
